description: Keep engineering work resumable in ChatGPT and Codex while turning confirmed failures into reusable repository knowledge.

interface.longDescription: Project OS keeps engineering work resumable across ChatGPT and Codex by storing context, plans, state and evidence inside each repository. It turns confirmed failures into reusable knowledge, including sanitized lessons that can be reviewed once and carried deliberately into other projects.
